headline: RBI issues final Securitisation Transactions Amendment Directions, 2026; effective April 1, 2027
summary_points: RBI has issued final Securitisation Transactions Amendment Directions after examining feedback on the draft issued on July 27, 2026.
Separate Amendment Directions are issued for four categories of regulated entities.
The guidelines come into force from April 01, 2027; a statement on feedback received is given in the Annex.

rows: RBI (Commercial Banks – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026
RBI (Small Finance Banks – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026
RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026
RBI (All India Financial Institutions – Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026

who_is_affected: Commercial banks, small finance banks, NBFCs and All India Financial Institutions engaged in securitisation transactions, along with their advisers and auditors.
action_required: Read the final Directions and the Annex on feedback, compare with the July 2026 draft, and plan compliance changes before April 1, 2027.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued the final Securitisation Transactions Amendment Directions, 2026 (Press Release 2026-2027/1550, dated November 23, 2026).

The final Directions follow the draft released on July 27, 2026. RBI has examined stakeholder feedback, incorporated modifications as deemed appropriate, and published a statement on the feedback in the Annex.

Separate Amendment Directions have been issued for:
- Commercial Banks
- Small Finance Banks
- Non-Banking Financial Companies
- All India Financial Institutions

The guidelines come into force from April 1, 2027, giving regulated entities time to align policies, systems and documentation.

Finance and compliance teams may wish to compare the final text with the draft to identify what changed after consultation, and begin an implementation plan early.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
